title: Bulk relaxation
action: Perform variable-cell relaxation of ferromagnetic bulk MnPt3 using DFT with LDA to obtain equilibrium lattice constant.
description: Determine the equilibrium lattice constant for the FM ground state. Used for all subsequent calculations.

title: Bulk magnetic configuration energies
action: Construct 16-atom supercells for FM, AFM₁, AFM₂, AFM₃ and run spin‑polarized DFT total energy calculations.
description: Generate energies E(FM), E(AFM₁), E(AFM₂), E(AFM₃) for Ising mapping.

title: Extract exchange constants
action: Map total energies onto Ising Hamiltonian to extract J1, J2, J3 and write bulk_exchange_constants.json.
description: Solve linear equations from the four total energies to obtain exchange parameters in mRy.

title: Surface slab calculations
action: Build slab supercells for (100) and (111) surfaces, run spin‑polarized DFT, compute layer‑resolved moments and Bader charges.
description: Compute electronic structure to extract magnetic moments and charge transfers.

title: Report surface properties
action: Compile layer‑resolved spin magnetic moments (μ_B) and charge transfers (e/atom) and write surface_moments_and_charges.json.
description: Output moments for both magnetic orderings; charges only for FM surfaces.
output_schema: object with keys FM(100), AFM(100), FM(111), AFM(111), charge_transfer_FM(100), charge_transfer_FM(111)
